definitions.explanation: A formal meeting or discussion between leaders, officials, or representatives, typically to address important matters.

examples.japanese: {首脳|しゅのう}{会談|かいだん}が{行|おこな}われた。
{両国|りょうこく}の{外相|がいしょう}が{会談|かいだん}した。
examples.english: The foreign ministers of both countries held talks.

examples.japanese: {大統領|だいとうりょう}との{会談|かいだん}で{貿易問題|ぼうえきもんだい}について{意見|いけん}を{交|か}わした。
examples.english: Views on trade issues were exchanged in the meeting with the president.

notes:
Used in diplomatic and political contexts. Implies a higher level of formality and importance than ordinary {会議|かいぎ} (meeting).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{首脳|しゅのう}{会談|かいだん} (summit meeting)
・{日米|にちべい}{会談|かいだん} (Japan-US talks)
・{電話|でんわ}{会談|かいだん} (telephone conference)
・{会談|かいだん}を{行|おこな}う (hold talks)
・{会談|かいだん}を{申|もう}し{入|い}れる (request a meeting)
